inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] {ℓ r : ℕ} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit κ}
  {tr : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → Fin C.size → Bool},
  (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), QuarticQuery.GateConsistent C x (tr x)) →
    ∀ {μ : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ},
      (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), μ x ≠ 0 → QuarticQuery.promised f x) →
        ∀ (J : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ → QuarticQuery.Column ℓ)
          (A : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ → Fin r → QuarticQuery.BitInput κ) (I : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ),
          QuarticQuery.prodW (QuarticQuery.prodW μ) A ≠ 0 →
            QuarticQuery.addressedF f C ℓ r (QuarticQuery.dummy J A) = Bool.false ∧
              QuarticQuery.addressedF f C ℓ r (QuarticQuery.planted f tr J A I) = Bool.true

lean.note: The generic addressedF theorem proves both values on the product support. Its type does not explicitly specialize to the concrete Fkm and canonical circuit in the row.
premises: Correct circuit transcript chooser; μ supported on promised inputs; sampled A has nonzero product weight.
